desc:

READY
SEASON

scripts.title: NOCTURNE  Instant Auto Snipe, Auto Sell, Auto Open & More

game.name: CASER - Open Cases & Upgrade Your Skins!

scripts.features:
MARKET

-Auto Snipe (min profit, min margin %, lots per pass, scan interval)
-Instant Resell (sells at item value right after purchase)
-Keep Knives (skips ★ items, leaves them for the market)
-Vanished Lot Cooldown (failed lot skipped for 30–60 s)
-Live Lots List (top 7 with profit and margin)
-Balance Guard (never buys above your cash)

FARMING

-Auto Click Coins (adaptive rate up to the server limit)
-Auto Collect (threshold in coins)
-Manual Collect Button
-Live Clicker Stats (clicks, collected, measured limit)

CASES

-Case Picker (search by name, prices shown)
-Auto Open (up to 10/s, no animation)
-Auto Sell Drops (one sell call per opening)
-Best EV Button (ranks every case by expected value)
-Balance Stop (halts and reports when cash is short)

VISUALS

-Session HUD (balance, profit, timer)
-Accent Color (6 swatches, live repaint)
-Hover Wave (light sweep on menu and buttons)
-Toasts (success, gold, error — toggleable)
-Fold and Unload (F1 / F2)

UTILITY

-Hotkeys (F1 fold, F2 unload, F3 clicker, F4 sniper)
-Upgrade Calculator (exact chance and EV)
-Profile Dump
-Admin Check
-Reset Stats
